subject.title: 3.9.6 fails to launch on macOS 15: missing @rpath/libswiftCompatibilitySpan.dylib

question: Which supported distribution strategy should the next CLI release use to satisfy the macOS 15 runtime dependency: static linkage of the compatibility runtime or a separately packaged, signed dylib?
rationale: Both choices affect the release artifact, code signing, notarization, and Homebrew installation layout; source inspection alone cannot safely choose between them.

options.title: Statically link the compatibility runtime
options.body: Prefer a static compatibility library when the Swift toolchain supports it, then prove the resulting standalone binary has no unresolved compatibility-dylib dependency.

options.title: Bundle and sign the dylib
options.body: Ship the required dylib beside the executable with a stable executable-relative rpath and update Homebrew installation plus upgrade checks accordingly.

options.title: Pause the next CLI release
options.body: Hold publication until one packaging route is verified from an extracted artifact on a clean macOS 15 system.

recommendation.title: Statically link the compatibility runtime
recommendation.body: Prefer a static compatibility library when the Swift toolchain supports it, then prove the resulting standalone binary has no unresolved compatibility-dylib dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: The release metadata directly associates steipete with the affected v3.9.6 artifact and its distribution pipeline.
